assessments.summary: The dependency is directly decoded and exhaustively checked: C has 152 distinct in-bounds points and is no-three-in-line; its dihedral orbit has two distinct point sets and the four translations yield exactly eight distinct embeddings in G_77. For each embedding, every outside cell has at least two blocking pairs, singleton deletion frees none, and pair deletion frees at most one. Exactly 16 deletion pairs free cells, comprising four pairs for each of four two-lines-of-two cells. The stated bounds for nearby no-three-in-line sets follow by setting R=E\S and A=S\E and observing that every added point must be unblocked after deleting R.
scopeQualifications: The conclusions apply separately only to the eight enumerated embeddings.
No conclusion is established for other 152-point configurations or for the global value of D(77).
